title: Run Prodigal using iMicrobe
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.veje3cn

steps.title: Select Sample and App
steps.instruction: Search for and select the desired sample in iMicrobe, add it to the cart, and launch the Prodigal app.

substeps.instruction: Search for and select the sample of interest.
Add the sample to the cart.
Navigate to the 'tools' dropdown menu and select 'Apps'.
Click on 'prodigal-2.6.3u2'.

steps.title: Configure App Parameters
steps.instruction: Provide input files via the CyVerse datastore and configure the Prodigal parameters based on the desired analysis mode.

substeps.instruction: Select the procedure: 'single' (for bacterial isolates) or 'meta' (for metagenomic samples).
Set 'write protein' to generate an output FASTA file with protein translations.
Set 'Write nucleotides' to generate an output FASTA file with nucleotide sequences.
Set 'Write all potential genes (with scores)' to create an output file containing all potential genes with associated prediction scores.
Choose the 'Output format': 'genbank' (default), 'gff', or 'Simple coordinate output'.
Optional: Enable 'Closed ends' to prevent partial genes at sequence edges if the first and last bases are known not to fall inside a gene.
Optional: Enable 'Treat runs of N as masked sequence' to prevent genes from being defined across gap sequences.

steps.title: Retrieve and Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Access the completed job outputs from the CyVerse datastore and navigate to the results folder.

substeps.instruction: Go to the 'Tools' dropdown menu and select 'Jobs'.
Select the corresponding job and navigate to the 'Outputs' section.
Click 'Browse and view output files in the CyVerse Datastore'.
Navigate to the 'prodigal-out' folder, which contains subfolders for each submitted genome.

steps.title: Interpret Output Files
steps.instruction: Review the generated files to extract gene coordinates, sequences, and scoring metadata.

substeps.instruction: Analyze 'prodigal.gbk/sco/gff' for gene coordinates and metadata (including seqnum, seqlen, seqhdr, version, run_type, model, gc_cont, transl_table, and uses_sd).

Review the scoring string in the output (ID, partial, start_type, stop_type, rbs_motif, rbs_spacer, gc_cont, gc_skew, conf, score, cscore, sscore, rscore, uscore, tscore, mscore) to evaluate gene validity.
Use 'nucl.fa' for predicted nucleotide sequences in FASTA format.
Use 'protein.fa' for predicted protein translations in FASTA format.

Use 'genes.txt' for a comprehensive tab-delimited table of all predicted genes before score filtering (including Beg, End, Std, Total, CodPot, StrtSc, Codon, RBSMot, Spacer, RBSScr, UpsScr, TypeScr, GCCont).
